relations.text: 2021年にグーグル・クラウドと10年間の戦略的提携を結んだ
relations.text_en: In 2021 CME entered a 10-year strategic partnership with Google Cloud

source.label: CME Group 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: Partnership with Google Cloud - In 2021, we entered into a 10-year strategic partnership with Google Cloud to accelerate our move to the cloud.

companies.name: フラッターのファンデュエル

relations.text: ファンデュエルとの合弁事業は2025年12月に始まった
relations.text_en: The joint venture with FanDuel launched in December 2025

source.label: CME Group 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: Our joint venture with FanDuel, a part of Flutter Entertainment plc, launched in December 2025.

relations.text: S&Pグローバルとの合弁を通じてS&P500の先物・オプションの独占ライセンスを持つ
relations.text_en: Through its JV with S&P Global, CME holds an exclusive license to list S&P 500 futures and options

source.label: CME Group 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: Through our joint venture with S&P Global, S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC, we have a long-term, ownership-linked, exclusive license to list futures and options based on the S&P 500 Index and certain other S&P indices.

relations.text: シンガポール取引所とは2027年4月までの相互オフセット契約がある
relations.text_en: CME and SGX have a mutual offset agreement with a current term through April 2027

source.label: CME Group 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: CME and Singapore Exchange Limited (SGX) maintain a mutual offset agreement with a current term through April 2027.

relations.text: DTCCとの提携で、清算参加者の証拠金の効率が高まった
relations.text_en: A partnership with DTCC offers enhanced capital efficiencies to eligible clearing firms

source.label: CME Group 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: We have enhanced our arrangement with FICC through the partnership with The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) to offer enhanced capital efficiencies to our eligible clearing firms.

source.quote: Our competitors include, among other entities, exchanges such as Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE), Cboe Global Markets (Cboe), Euronext N.V., the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX), and Deutsche Börse AG.
